recommendations.name: South Route
recommendations.summary: Rename this route to 'North Ridge', because everything on it already describes the north ridge climbed from Swamp Creek, and no route on the south side of this peak is known.
recommendations.detail: The first-ascent report (2006) and the only detailed modern trip report (Sept 2023) both climb Needle Peak by its north ridge from Swamp Creek, off the Agnes Creek trail. Neither source, nor any other report found, mentions a route on the south side. This row's beta, face ('North Ridge'), aspect (N), waypoints, approach, descent_text and itinerary all describe that north-ridge line, so only the name is wrong. Once renamed, it should become the peak's single North Ridge row, and the sibling wa_needle_peak_north_ridge should be moved off this peak (see that recommendation) so the name is not duplicated. The first-ascent report calls the Needle section 'low 5th class', which supports the row's 'Class 4 (5.0 crux)' grade over pitch_detail's Class 3. Fix pitch_detail and the 'narrow summit step' wording in partner_requirements and seasonal_hazards.exposure at the same time.

recommendations.name: North Ridge
recommendations.summary: Move this route to Bonanza Peak and call it the Northwest Ridge traverse, because it describes a two-day climb that finishes on Bonanza, while Needle Peak's own north ridge is already covered by the other Needle Peak route.
recommendations.detail: The only source for this row's content is the 2006 first-ascent report. That report presents the whole Needle Peak -> North and South Anonymity Towers -> Dark Peak -> Bonanza link-up as one new route on Bonanza Peak, the Northwest Ridge (V 5.8), with Needle's north ridge as its opening stage. This row's overview, beta, itinerary, hazards, obj_haz, bail and watch_out all describe that traverse, including glacier travel on the Dark and Mary Green glaciers. On Needle Peak it duplicates the renamed wa_needle_peak_south_route. The target area is Bonanza Peak (wa_bonanza_peak). Its catalog has no Northwest Ridge row: the Bonanza 'West Ridge' row was deleted as fabricated on 2026-09-24, so this does not duplicate anything. If refiled, give it the name 'Northwest Ridge (from Needle Peak)' and the grade V 5.8. Its waypoints (summit = Needle Peak) should end on Bonanza's summit. The 'single documented ascent' wording in season and best_season should go, since only the full traverse is single-ascent. If the owner does not want a traverse row at all, the fallback is merge_into wa_needle_peak_south_route, keeping just the 2006 history sentence.

recommendations.name: Lewis Creek Route
recommendations.summary: Fold this route into Gunn Peak's standard Southeast Route and delete it, keeping only the note that the 1915 first ascent came up Lewis Creek, because nobody describes a separate modern Lewis Creek climb and everything on this route is the standard route.
recommendations.detail: Every source agrees only that the 1915 first ascent (Hinman, Eriksen, Lesh) went 'via Lewis Creek'. None of them gives any modern beta for a Lewis Creek line. Modern reports and route pages describe one standard way up: the Barclay Creek climbers' path to Tailgunner Pass and the hidden ramp, class 3-4, with a north-side ledge to the summit. They also describe a snow-season Tailgunner Couloir variant and a few Burdo rock routes, but no Lewis Creek route. This row's approach, approach_variants, pitch_detail, waypoints, descent_text and pro_tips all describe that standard Barclay Creek route, and only the itinerary and timing notes claim a separate north/west-side line. That claim has no source, and the row's own rope_note admits no beta exists under this name. Merge into wa_gunn_peak_southeast_route and carry over only the first-ascent sentence (the date, the party, fifth attempt, via Lewis Creek) as history.

recommendations.name: West Face
recommendations.summary: Keep this as the West Face ramp route, a short low-fifth-class climb up the big treed ramp, and remove the six-pitch 5.8 details, which belong to the separate Improbable Traverse route.
recommendations.detail: The Mountaineers' Guye Peak/West Face route follows a very large, tree-covered ramp rising north to south across the face. It then climbs about 40 ft of class 4 to low 5th rock and a second ramp to a notch, and its crux is roughly 30 ft of low 5th class. From the south summit it descends past the middle peak with about 100 ft of rappel/downclimb. This row's beta, itinerary, timing and descent_text match that route. Its rock_grade (5.8), grade_num 8, pitches 6, length_m 610, alpine grade II-III, fa (Hiser/Borghoff 1960, which is the Improbable Traverse), pitch_detail, and the notes about 2021 rockfall on the 'traverse pitch' (hazards, turnaround, bail, obj_haz, descent) describe the Improbable Traverse, which already has its own row (wa_guye_peak_improbable_traverse). Those fields should be rewritten to the West Face ramp route: roughly low 5th class, with a light alpine rack.
fields_affected: overview (drop 'best-known line is the Improbable Traverse' framing)

recommendations.name: North Face
recommendations.summary: Split this into two routes: rename this one 'Northeast Face Couloir', since most of its content is about that climb, and create a new 'North Face' route for the harder chimney-and-rib climb whose summary and pitch list are currently on it.
recommendations.detail: Two different documented climbs are fused here. The first is the North Face (IV 5.10), climbed in 1988 by Burdo and Cairns: four pitches up a central chimney, three on an exposed rib, then a gully of huge chockstones. This row's overview, beta, pitch_detail, pitches, hazards and watch_out describe it. The second is the Northeast Face Couloir, credited to Kloke and Simon (the year is given as 1972, 1974 or 1976 in different sources) and climbed in winter on 13 March 2005 by Miller and Taylor. The fa, grade 5.6, aspect NE, face, season, best_season, gear, detailed_rack, pro_needs, rappels, turnaround, bail, descent, descent_text, itinerary, timing, what_to_bring and waypoints come from that 2005 report. Both are genuine documented climbs, so rename this row to 'Northeast Face Couloir' and keep those fields. Then move overview, beta, pitch_detail, pitches, hazards[0] and watch_out into a new 'North Face' row with grade IV 5.10 and FA Burdo/Cairns 1988. Leave the Kloke-Simon year blank or give a range until a primary source settles it.
